gloss: one or the other; either one; one of (two things)

definitions.gloss: one or the other (of two options); either one
definitions.explanation: Combines どちら (which of two) with the indefinite particle か. Picks out an unspecified one from a pair — usually translated as 'either one', 'one of the two', or 'whichever'.

examples.japanese: どちらか⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pick one of the two.
If I had to choose, I'd say I prefer black tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{電子版|でんしばん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、どちらか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{選|えら}び→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: You can choose either the paper or the digital version.

notes:
Refers to a pair, not three or more. Use ⟦どれか→どれか：22606_doreka⟧ for three or more options. The casual contraction ⟦どっちか→どっちか：26335_docchika⟧ is extremely common in speech.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- どちらか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: if I had to say which; if anything
- どちらか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: if one had to choose between them
- どちらか⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧: one or the other (of the two)
- どちらか⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose between two

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どちらも→どちらも：08721_dochiramo⟧: both — covers the pair
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: either is fine; any one will do
- ⟦どれか→どれか：22606_doreka⟧: any one of (three or more)
- ⟦どっちか→どっちか：26335_docchika⟧: casual contracted form
